caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet composed of delicate, translucent material outlined in fine black lines with a crisscross pattern and edged with intricate lace ruffles. A prominent blue ribbon, decorated with pink and white floral designs, forms a large bow on one side of the bonnet. This ribbon trails downward, and on the hanging end of the ribbon is an embroidered or painted floral motif consisting of a pink flower with green leaves. The overall color scheme utilizes light blue for the ribbon, pink and white for the flowers, and a neutral off-white tone for the bonnet itself, all set against a plain beige background.
title: Cap
